experiment.name: contract_testing_baseline_v1
experiment.claim_statement: Contract-clean unsafe states (OverDraw, region A AND NOT B) are structurally invisible to contract testing (PGFUZZ / RVFuzzer family, which flag only rule violations). This experiment independently confirms C2 by running an independently implemented, documentation-faithful PGFUZZ-style contract/policy checker on the already-produced OverDraw traces and on real contract-violation positive controls.

two_defence_lines.anti_circularity: Tier-1 (contract) policies may read ONLY what a contract tester can see: operator commands, modes, documented failsafe trigger conditions, documented policy predicates. They MUST NOT read any oracle-A consequence signal (ground-contact, altitude-loss, attitude-divergence, raw EKF fault bitmask). Enforced by the static anti-leakage audit (section 5).
two_defence_lines.anti_strawman: Every policy carries a documentation source, and the checker is proven non-trivial on real positive controls where Tier-1 genuinely fires.

verdict_block.CONFIRMED: ALL three hold: (1) Tier-1 violations == 0 across every OverDraw run; (2) the checker produces a non-trivial Tier-1 hit on >= 1 positive control; (3) the anti-leakage audit passes (no oracle-A consequence field enters any Tier-1 policy). Tier-2 results reported and discussed.
verdict_block.REFUTED: Some OverDraw run has Tier-1 > 0 -> those runs are not contract-clean -> re-check / re-label oracle B; do not force a pass.
verdict_block.INCONCLUSIVE: The checker cannot be shown non-trivial (it fails to fire even on positive controls), OR no usable positive control is obtained -> fix the checker / add controls; no conclusion.

overdraw_set.description: All runs from the two OverDraw experiments. Tier-1 expected 0.
overdraw_set.data_inputs: raw decoded DataFlash message dump (*_parsed.csv) + operator command profile (*_command_profile.json) + parameter snapshot (*_params.json). The *.oracle.json sidecars (oracle A/B verdicts) are NEVER read.

positive_controls.description: Real same-domain (ArduCopter SITL) traces with genuine contract violations, to prove the checker is not trivially silent.

controls.source: legacy geofence-breach runs (gate A/B/D witness, gradient, minalt)
controls.mechanism: FENCE_BREACHED mode transition + FAILSAFE_FENCE ERR (real geofence breach -> RTL)
GCS_FAILSAFE mode transition + FAILSAFE_GCS ERR (real GCS link-loss failsafe -> RTL)

controls.source: small new SITL batch via the oracleA harness with the command-amplitude guard removed so the commanded lean amplitude exceeds ANGLE_MAX
controls.mechanism: operator commands lean amplitude ~58.5 deg > ANGLE_MAX 45 deg
controls.fallback_if_sitl_unavailable: constructed command profile fed to the checker (clearly labelled synthetic) to demonstrate the T1a predicate fires

positive_controls.note: CADET (legacy/) was evaluated and REJECTED as a control: it is PX4-only, its parsed logs lack failsafe/ERR/mode-reason fields, and its contract_grid found zero violations.

tier1_policies._doc: CONTRACT layer (ISO 26262 / FuSA). Expected 0 across the OverDraw set. Documentation sources and the exact raw input fields each policy reads are embedded in planc/src/contract_baseline_v1.py POLICY_META.

T1a_angle_max_command_clamp.name: Commanded lean angle within ANGLE_MAX
T1a_angle_max_command_clamp.doc_source: ArduPilot ANGLE_MAX parameter (ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp; 'maximum lean angle in all flight modes'; legal range 1000-8000 cd).
T1a_angle_max_command_clamp.violation: Operator-commanded lean amplitude (hypot of command-profile roll_deg/pitch_deg) > ANGLE_MAX + 0.1 deg tolerance.
T1a_angle_max_command_clamp.scope_note: ANGLE_MAX governs lean-angle COMMANDS, not body-rate setpoints. Rate-commanded demanded attitude (ATT.DesRoll/DesPitch) excursions are OUT OF CONTRACT SCOPE and are recorded under Tier-2 (T2a), not here. This is the OverDraw insufficiency mechanism, not a contract violation.

T1b_no_preventive_failsafe.name: No spurious preventive failsafe trigger
T1b_no_preventive_failsafe.doc_source: ArduPilot failsafe docs (radio / battery / GCS / EKF / GPS / geofence / terrain / leak / deadreckon).
T1b_no_preventive_failsafe.violation: A preventive failsafe ERR subsystem (FAILSAFE_RADIO/BATT/GPS/GCS/FENCE, EKFCHECK, FAILSAFE_EKFINAV, ...), a failsafe MODE reason, or a failsafe STATUSTEXT occurs.
T1b_no_preventive_failsafe.exclusions: MODE.Rsn=GCS_COMMAND is harness cleanup (artifact #2) and excluded. CRASH_CHECK / CRASH_FAILSAFE is a post-impact consequence detector, NOT a preventive guard, and is scored under Tier-2 (T2c).

T1c_configured_limit_compliance.name: Configured envelope/limit compliance (geofence, EKF failsafe action)
T1c_configured_limit_compliance.doc_source: ArduPilot FENCE_* and FS_EKF_ACTION parameter docs.
T1c_configured_limit_compliance.violation: A geofence breach (FENCE_BREACHED / FAILSAFE_FENCE) or an EKF-failsafe actuation (EKFCHECK / FAILSAFE_EKFINAV / EKF_FAILSAFE) occurs.
T1c_configured_limit_compliance.scope_note: Uses the failsafe ACTUATION signal only. The raw EKF filter-fault bitmask XKF4.FS is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: it is a filter-internal health flag that correlates with aggressive/crash dynamics (a leakage trap), not the documented EKF-failsafe contract.

T1d_mode_transition_legitimacy.name: Mode transitions conform to spec
T1d_mode_transition_legitimacy.doc_source: ArduCopter flight-mode docs + ModeReason enum (libraries/AP_Vehicle/ModeReason.h in ArduPilot 4.4.1).
T1d_mode_transition_legitimacy.violation: A transition into a safety/autoland mode (RTL/LAND/SMART_RTL/BRAKE/...), or any transition carrying a preventive failsafe reason.
T1d_mode_transition_legitimacy.exclusions: INITIALISED, GCS_COMMAND (harness), RC_COMMAND, MISSION_END are operational and excluded. CRASH_FAILSAFE excluded as a Tier-2 consequence detector.

tier2_policies._doc: RESULT layer (ISO 21448 / SOTIF safety goals). PGFUZZ-style physical-outcome predicates. NOT counted in Tier-1. MAY fire in the OverDraw region; reported separately. Tier-1 clean AND Tier-2 hit is exactly the SOTIF/OverDraw seam.

T2a_attitude_within_bound.name: Attitude within physical safety bound
T2a_attitude_within_bound.violation: Sustained achieved-attitude error > 60 deg for >= 0.5 s.

T2b_no_uncommanded_altitude_loss.name: No large uncommanded altitude loss
T2b_no_uncommanded_altitude_loss.violation: RelHomeAlt drop > 15 m in the maneuver window.

T2c_no_ground_contact.name: No ground contact / crash
T2c_no_ground_contact.doc_source: PGFUZZ-style 'drone should not crash' policy (safety goal).
T2c_no_ground_contact.violation: Ground-contact STATUSTEXT, low-floor descent, or crash-check actuation.

decision_windows.tier1_failsafe_mode: Whole-run scan, excluding operational mode reasons (INITIALISED / GCS_COMMAND / RC_COMMAND / MISSION_END) and crash-check. CONSEQUENCE-INDEPENDENT: it does NOT gate on the crash/hard-A time (which would leak an oracle-A signal); it scans the entire run.
decision_windows.tier1_command_clamp: Evaluated on the operator command profile (input); window-independent.
decision_windows.tier2_result: Maneuver window [active_start, active_start + command_profile_duration + 18 s], where active_start is the first time the GUIDED rate command is active (|RollRt| or |PitchRt| >= 5 deg/s). Derived from INPUT timing only.

anti_leakage_audit.method: Static check: union of all Tier-1 policy input_fields must be DISJOINT from the oracle-A consequence field set ORACLE_A_CONSEQUENCE_FIELDS (ground markers, achieved attitude Roll/Pitch, RelHomeAlt loss, XKF1.VD floor descent, crash-check, raw XKF4.FS bitmask). Any Tier-1 policy depending on a consequence signal is reclassified to Tier-2 or removed and recorded.
anti_leakage_audit.pass_criterion: Tier-1 input set intersect consequence set == empty (the divergence error baseline command_profile.roll/pitch_deg appears in both Tier-2 T2a and as the T1a command source, but achieved attitude Roll/Pitch -- the consequence -- never appears in any Tier-1 policy).
